description: This file defines a custom Android View class 'GameView' which implements a simple joystick-controlled physics game. It includes inner classes for game entities such as Ship, Bullet, and Obstacle, and handles user input, game logic, rendering, and obstacle management.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: A custom View handling game logic, rendering, and input for a basic joystick-based game.

classes.name: Sprite
classes.description: Abstract base class for game entities with position, velocity, size, and collision detection.

classes.name: Ship
classes.description: Represents the player's spaceship, handling movement, rotation, rendering, and destruction effects.

classes.name: Bullet
classes.description: Represents projectiles fired by the ship, handling movement, rendering, and destruction.

classes.name: Obstacle
classes.description: Represents obstacles in the game, moving independently, with rendering and collision detection.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles resizing of the view, resets the game state.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Processes key presses for directional input and firing; updates ship heading accordingly.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key release events to stop movement or actions.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Processes joystick movement input to control the ship.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Updates game state for the current frame and schedules next frame.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Advances game entities' positions, handles collisions, and spawns obstacles.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws all game entities to the canvas.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires a new bullet from the ship's current position and velocity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: crash
methods.description: Triggers a vibration pattern indicating the ship has crashed.
